answer: Sponsor-liable invitation trees make every new seat cost an existing member real exposure. A newcomer joins only through a sponsor who locks 200 POA per invite and may issue at most 3 invites per epoch. If an invitee is later proven fake, for example by turning in a copied bridge inspection or a duplicated oasis water survey, the sponsor loses that 200 POA and its invite rights for 10 epochs. A 300-fake farm needs 100 sponsor-epochs and 60,000 POA at risk, and caught fakes cannot wander to fresh sponsors, since each sponsor needs its own passed history.
